ai.seo_question: What does the 'lengthened shadow' of the Prophet mean in Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Muddaththir is often interpreted as a dual reference to the physical shade of the Kaaba in this world and the spiritual shade of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) and the Ahl al-Bayt in the Hereafter. It underscores the concept of 'Wilayah' as a source of divine protection, where the faithful find refuge from the heat of reckoning under the intercession of the Imams. This imagery highlights the continuity of guidance from the Prophet's life to his eternal presence in Paradise.
